---
title: "GSE32628"
output:
  pdf_document: default
  html_document: default
---

```{r}
library(GEOquery)
library(limma)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)

# 1. Download
gse <- getGEO("GSE32628", destdir = ".", getGPL = TRUE)[[1]]
exprs_mat <- exprs(gse)
metadata <- pData(gse)

# 2. Clean Metadata
# GSE32628 usually has "normal", "actinic keratosis", and "squamous cell carcinoma" 
# in the 'title' or 'description' columns.
metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(Condition = case_when(
    grepl("normal skin", source_name_ch1, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "NS",
    grepl("actinic keratosis", source_name_ch1, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "AK",
    grepl("cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma", source_name_ch1, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "cSCC",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )) %>%
  mutate(Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("NS", "AK", "cSCC")))

# 3. Map Probe IDs to Gene Symbols (GPL570)
feature_data <- fData(gse)
# Standard column for Gene Symbols in GPL570 is usually 'Gene Symbol' or 'SYMBOL'
symbol_col <- grep("SYMBOL|Gene.Symbol", colnames(feature_data), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]

probe_mapping <- feature_data %>%
  select(ID, Symbol = !!sym(symbol_col)) %>%
  filter(Symbol != "" & !is.na(Symbol)) %>%
  mutate(Symbol = gsub(" ///.*", "", Symbol)) # Keep first symbol if multiple

# Filter for your specific markers
target_genes <- c("TWIST1", "OVOL1", "KLF4", "IVL", "LOR", "KRT1", "KRT10", "MYC")
selected_probes <- probe_mapping %>% filter(Symbol %in% target_genes)

# 4. Extract and Average Probes
clean_exprs <- exprs_mat[as.character(selected_probes$ID), ]
rownames(clean_exprs) <- selected_probes$Symbol
clean_exprs_unique <- avereps(clean_exprs, ID = rownames(clean_exprs))
```
```{r}
# Prepare plotting data
plot_df <- as.data.frame(t(clean_exprs_unique))
plot_df$Condition <- metadata$Condition

# Faceted Scatter Plot
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = TWIST1, y = OVOL1)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Condition), size = 3.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", linetype = "dashed", se = TRUE) +
  stat_cor(method = "spearman", label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "top") + 
  facet_wrap(~Condition, scales = "free") + 
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("NS" = "#2c7bb6", "AK" = "#fdae61", "cSCC" = "#d7191c")) +
  labs(
    title = "GSE32628: TWIST1 vs OVOL1 Correlation by Stage",
    subtitle = "Spearman Rho across cSCC progression",
    x = "TWIST1 (log2 Intensity)",
    y = "OVOL1 (log2 Intensity)"
  )
```
```{r}
# Calculate Spearman Correlation
cor_mat <- cor(t(clean_exprs_unique), method = "spearman")

library(pheatmap)
pheatmap(cor_mat[c("TWIST1", "OVOL1"), ], 
         display_numbers = TRUE,
         main = "Correlation: TWIST1/OVOL1 vs. Proliferation & Differentiation Markers",
         color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(100))
```

```{r}
# Reshape for boxplot
long_df <- plot_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Condition, names_to = "Gene", values_to = "Expression") %>%
  filter(Gene %in% c("TWIST1", "OVOL1"))

# Use your existing long_df
ggplot(long_df, aes(x = Condition, y = Expression, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  # Adding jittered points helps show the actual sample size per group
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4, size = 1) + 
  facet_wrap(~Gene, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  # 1. Change to ANOVA for a global p-value across all 3 groups
  stat_compare_means(method = "anova", label.y.npc = "top", label.x.npc = 0.1) +
  # 2. Add pairwise comparisons to see exactly WHERE the shift happens
  # (e.g., NS vs AK, AK vs cSCC)
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("NS", "AK"), c("AK", "cSCC"), c("NS", "cSCC")),
                     label = "p.signif", 
                     method = "t.test",
                     step.increase = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("NS" = "#66c2a5", "AK" = "#fc8d62", "cSCC" = "#8da0cb")) +
  labs(
    title = "Gene Expression Shift Across cSCC Progression",
    subtitle = "Global ANOVA with Pairwise T-tests",
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Expression (log2 Intensity)"
  ) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```
The asterisk at the very top indicates a significant difference between conditions.
